toegepas.voor: Die blomme verskil van klein blommetjies
toegepas.na: Die blomme wissel van klein blommetjies
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'verskil van' reads as 'differ from' (the flowers differ from small flowers); 'wissel van ... tot' is the natural Afrikaans for a range.
toegepas.fout: 'verskil van klein blommetjies' first reads as 'differ from small flowers', not as a range.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'wissel van ... tot' is the natural Afrikaans for a range and keeps the same meaning; no protected wording is touched.

toegepas.voor: Die vrugte verskil van 'n klein bessie
toegepas.na: Die vrugte wissel van 'n klein bessie
toegepas.rede_vinder: Same fault: 'verskil van' means 'differ from'; 'wissel van ... tot' expresses the range.
toegepas.fout: 'verskil van 'n klein bessie' first reads as 'differ from a small berry', not as a range.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same fix as change 1, and it keeps the flower and fruit sentences parallel.

toegepas.voor: ander het vere en party het skubbe
toegepas.na: ander het vere, en party het skubbe
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb, matching the slang/skilpad sentence earlier in the block.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The clauses are full sentences, not a list of words, and the comma matches the slang/skilpad and flamink/renoster sentences in the same block.

toegepas.voor: Op die Aarde is daar baie soorte habitatte
toegepas.na: Op die Aarde is daar baie verskillende habitatte
toegepas.rede_vinder: In this lesson 'soort' means a species, so 'soorte habitatte' blurs the term; 'verskillende' says the same without the clash.
toegepas.fout: 'soorte habitatte' uses 'soort' loosely in a lesson where 'soort' means a species, right before 'baie soorte plante' in that sense.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'baie verskillende habitatte' says the same thing without blurring the term, in line with the lesson's own 'groepe' not 'soorte' ruling.

toegepas.blok: Suid-Afrika se eie plante en diere
toegepas.rede_vinder: Same as above: keep 'soort' for species and use 'verskillende' for kinds of habitat.
toegepas.fout: Same loose use of 'soort' for habitats, in the paragraph that leads into biodiversity as a variety of species.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same fix as change 4; the meaning and the list of habitats stay the same.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Baie proteas het breë, leeragtige blare, soos die koningprotea.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Baie proteas, soos die koningprotea, het breë, leeragtige blare.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: At the end of the sentence 'soos die koningprotea' can read as a comparison with the leaves; placed after 'Baie proteas' it is clearly the example, and the protected wordings 'Baie proteas' and 'koningprotea' stay intact.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: This is a shared glossary definition and the original already reads naturally, with 'soos die koningprotea' attaching to the proteas; either reading is true, so moving it is a lateral change in a definition a language agent should not reword.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Suid-Afrika se eie plante en diere
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Niemand het hom uit 'n ander land hierheen gebring nie.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Niemand het dit uit 'n ander land hierheen gebring nie.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The antecedent is ''n plant of 'n dier'; the neutral 'dit' covers both more cleanly than 'hom', in line with the earlier round that replaced 'hy' in the same block.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'hom' for 'n plant of 'n dier is normal Afrikaans and points unambiguously to the preceding phrase, so 'dit' is only a different, equally natural pronoun.
